title: Andromeda Galaxy - January 29 2024
object: M31 Andromeda Galaxy (with M32 and M110)
author_credit: "Andromeda Galaxy - January 29 2024" by Kevin M. Gill, licensed under CC BY 2.0
verification_note: Viewed: whole M31 at an angle, warm core, dust lanes, dark star field. Amateur photo (ZWO ASI183MC-Pro, Tamron 150mm). Flickr page checked 2026-11-01 still shows CC BY 2.0; Commons Flickr review passed. Less vivid than the Evans image and spiral structure is subtle; 15.3 MB PNG, recompress for the app. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/53460575@N03/53497470397/

title: M31, the Andromeda Galaxy (now with h-alpha)
object: M31 Andromeda Galaxy (with M32 and M110)
author_credit: "M31, the Andromeda Galaxy (now with h-alpha)" by Adam Evans, licensed under CC BY 2.0
license: CC BY 2.0 at Commons upload; author has since changed Flickr page to CC BY-NC 2.0 - NOT CLEARED BY DEFAULT
verification_note: DECISION NEEDED, do not ship by default. Best visual match to the brief. Commons Flickr review (2011-01-10) recorded CC BY 2.0 and the file carries Flickr-change-of-license: CC licences cannot be revoked, so the grant stands per Commons. But the Flickr page checked 2026-11-01 shows CC BY-NC 2.0, so proof of the commercial grant rests on the Commons record and the author no longer offers it. Also includes H-alpha narrowband data. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/astroporn/4999978603/

title: Hubble's sharpest view of the Orion Nebula (heic0601a)
author_credit: NASA, ESA, M. Robberto (Space Telescope Science Institute/ESA) and the Hubble Space Telescope Orion Treasury Project Team
verification_note: Viewed: pink, magenta and orange M42 mosaic. Credit quoted from ESA/Hubble page. ESA/Hubble terms: CC BY 4.0, listed organisations need not be contacted, credit must stay unaltered and no endorsement implied.

title: Saturn Four Years On (PIA11141)
verification_note: Viewed: natural-colour Cassini mosaic, tan tones, on black, planet large in frame. NASA page calls it natural color. Downloaded the 2.2 MB Commons copy of the same 4613x2233 image because NASA JPEG is heavily compressed (0.26 MB); NASA TIFF is 29 MB. CICLOPS (Cassini imaging team) own policy site was unreachable, so the licence basis is NASA and JPL policy.

title: Saturn Four Years On (PIA11141)
verification_note: Reuses saturn.jpg as requested.

title: The Greatest Saturn Portrait...Yet (PIA06193)
verification_note: Viewed: warmer, wide open rings, planet shadow across rings. Extra option, 8888 px wide (above the 3000 px target, file is 5.7 MB). Same CICLOPS note as saturn.

title: CGI Moon Kit - lroc_color_poles_4k
verification_note: Viewed: 2:1 lunar map, 8-bit TIFF. SVS FAQ: all content is public domain unless otherwise noted; page 4720 has no such note. Credit quoted from page. Built from LROC WAC data; LROC restricts commercial use of its own website imagery but not PDS products, and SVS publishes this derivative as public domain. Pale grey polar bands visible at top and bottom.

title: View of a full Moon photographed from Apollo 11 spacecraft (AS11-44-6667)
verification_note: Viewed: real full-disc photograph on black, not the Revera image. Important: taken from beyond the Moon on the way home, so it shows the eastern and far side rather than the Earth-facing view people recognise. Use moon_nearside_render where the familiar face matters.

title: Full Moon
author_credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio
verification_note: Viewed: clean Earth-facing full Moon on black, no label. COMPUTER RENDER, not a photograph (NASA calls it a computer simulation), so do not caption it as a photo. Credit quoted from NASA description.

title: Earth at Night: Black Marble 2016 Color Maps (3km)
author_credit: NASA Earth Observatory images by Joshua Stevens, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data from Miguel Román, NASA GSFC
verification_note: Viewed: 2:1 night-lights map. Credit quoted from NASA SVS page 5477, which reuses this data; the current maps page shows no credit and Visible Earth now redirects. Archived EO policy allowed commercial reuse and said the only mandatory credit is NASA; current policy page could not be read directly, NASA media guidelines used instead. 13500x6750, larger than requested.

title: Blue Marble Next Generation, December 2004, topography and bathymetry
verification_note: Viewed: 2:1 cloud-free map with snow cover and bathymetry. NASA page: "Anyone using or republishing Blue Marble: Next Generation please credit NASA Earth Observatory"; produced by Reto Stöckli. December month is inferred from the 200412 filename because the 73909 page now redirects. Northern snow suits winter; other months exist if you want summer.

title: Jupiter's Colourful Palette (heic1914a)
author_credit: NASA, ESA, A. Simon (Goddard Space Flight Center), and M.H. Wong (University of California, Berkeley)
verification_note: Viewed: whole disc on black, Great Red Spot, bands tilted diagonally (rotate if wanted, and disclose the change). Hubble colour processing is vivid, so treat as approximate natural colour. Credit quoted from ESA/Hubble page.

title: Cassini Jupiter Portrait (PIA04866)
verification_note: Viewed: the image you named. True colour per NASA, but it is a half-lit view, NOT a whole disc, so jupiter.jpg is the primary. Same CICLOPS note as saturn.

title: Mars in opposition 2016 (heic1609a)
author_credit: NASA, ESA, the Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA), J. Bell (ASU), and M. Wolff (Space Science Institute)
verification_note: Viewed: clean whole disc on black with polar cap and clouds. Credit quoted from ESA/Hubble page.

title: Venus from Mariner 10 (PIA23791, Figure A)
verification_note: Viewed: mild cream colour, whole disc on black. NASA calls this a false color composite (orange and ultraviolet filters), so do not caption it true colour. Processed by JPL engineer Kevin M. Gill. Only 1096 px and 44 KB. Figure B is the contrast-enhanced version.

title: Photomosaic of Mercury: Outbound View (PIA03104)
verification_note: Viewed: PARTIAL MATCH. Mariner 10 greyscale half-lit mosaic with stepped tile edges, not the colour MESSENGER whole disc requested. MESSENGER was rejected: JHU/APL limits its images to non-commercial educational and public information use.

title: Uranus as seen by NASA's Voyager 2 (PIA18182)
verification_note: Viewed: Voyager 2 whole disc on black. TIFF chosen over the 79 KB JPEG. Very smooth detail is expected for Uranus.

title: Neptune Full Disk View (PIA01492)
verification_note: Viewed: Voyager 2 whole disc on black with Great Dark Spot. Green and orange filter composite; blue is stronger than Neptune appears to the eye, so avoid calling it true colour.

title: M45 Pleiades (noao-m45)
author_credit: NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/T.A. Rector (University of Alaska Anchorage), R. Cool (University of Arizona) and WIYN
verification_note: Viewed: core of the Pleiades, blue reflection nebulosity, orange background stars, on black. Substitute for the requested Hubble/Palomar version: that one uses POSS-II data which STScI lists as copyright Caltech, with commercial use unaddressed. Credit quoted from NOIRLab; https://noirlab.edu/public/copyright/ gives CC BY 4.0 and bars implying endorsement.

title: 370-million-pixel starscape of the Lagoon Nebula (eso0936a)
verification_note: Viewed: pink and red nebula in a dense star field. ESO page credit is just "ESO" (Commons adds S. Guisard, ESO wording used). https://www.eso.org/public/outreach/copyright/ requires credit unaltered and visible, disclosure of modifications, and no implied endorsement.

title: Out of this whirl: The Whirlpool Galaxy (M51) and companion galaxy (heic0506a)
author_credit: NASA, ESA, S. Beckwith (STScI), and The Hubble Heritage Team (STScI/AURA)
verification_note: Viewed: face-on spiral with companion NGC 5195. Credit quoted from ESA/Hubble page; the Commons field was incomplete.

title: Jasper
object: Snow-capped mountains at dusk, Jasper National Park, Alberta
author_credit: "Jasper" by Janusz Sobolewski, licensed under CC BY 2.0
verification_note: Viewed: real photo, snow peaks, dark forest band, orange streaks in a grey-violet sky. Good but not perfect: forest is mid-ground with an icy river in front, so crop the bottom (disclose the change). Commons thumbnail of the 5616x3195 original. Flickr page checked 2026-11-01 still shows CC BY 2.0; Commons Flickr review passed 2023-12-20. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/yanush63/53400617559/

title: Teton Range at Sunset
verification_note: Viewed: real photo, pink and orange sky over snowy peaks, thin dark tree line, snowfield in front. No attribution legally needed; courtesy credit given. Flickr review passed with Public Domain Mark 2025-04-08. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/grandtetonnps/52098552473

title: Sunset Forest Silhouette, Mt Baker Snoqualmie National Forest
author_credit: U.S. Forest Service - Pacific Northwest Region
verification_note: Viewed: real photo, strong dark conifer silhouettes. PARTIAL MATCH: golden sunset sky with the sun visible, not blue-to-orange dusk. Flickr review passed. No attribution legally needed; courtesy credit given. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/forestservicenw/31959348222/
